annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes OneCoin as a cryptocurrency business opportunity, promises that token portfolios can double in less than 10 weeks, and urges viewers to register immediately. It also encourages recruitment by offering rewards for building a team and emphasizes limited positions, creating a direct solicitation built around token-return and downline-income claims.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video explicitly links earnings and bonuses to building a multi-person team or sales structure, including qualifying for bonuses by building one's own sales team. S05 is also supported because the promoted token program claims that token portfolios can be doubled, tying participation in the token scheme to holding-related gains.
